newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares end up on domestic buying.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares end up on domestic buying.

text.p: Shanghai B shares rose on Monday mainly on domestic institutional buying, but the index was off the morning's high on profit-taking due to market uncertainties, brokers said.

The B index rose 1.663 points or 1.77 percent to 95.794 points, down from an intraday high of 97.865 points. Volume was 32.437 million shares worth $22.180 million, compared with $22.644 million on Friday.
Profit-taking was seen at high levels and institutions are mixed over the market outlook, so volume did not grow, brokers said.
Strong A share performance is the main factor behind the B share gains, but the continuing surge in the A share markets is increasing concerns about a possible government clampdown, brokers said.
"Recent domestic A share movements are abnormal," said one broker. "Beijing will not tolerate the over-speculative market."
"The B index will move between 93 to 98 points in the next few days if their is no major negative news in sight," another broker said.
Of 43 shares, 42 traded, with 24 up, nine flat and nine down.
Inner Mongolia Erdos Cashmere Products was the star on institutional buying to support its new 100 million share issue, surging $0.102 or 9.98 percent to $1.124 on volume of 706,200 shares.

Shanghai Refrigerator Compressor was the most actively traded and become the second-biggest winner on heavy institutional buying, soaring $0.082 or 9.95 percent to $0.906 on volume of 2.5 million shares.

Shanghai's A shares continued to power ahead despite concerns about possible government measures to rein the markets in, supported by huge fresh capital flows flooding into the market to reap quick profits, brokers said.
The index rose 34.884 points or 2.27 percent to 1,568.999 points on volume of 1.1 billion shares worth 15.8 billion yuan.
The SSE30 blue chip index edged up 5.968 points or 0.14 percent to 4,286.182 points.
Beijing Tianqiao Department was the biggest winner on institutional buying, surging 0.89 yuan or 10.04 percent to 9.75 yuan on volume of 4.9 million shares.
